concept: Learning a skill through repetition and deliberate practice, not just doing it once
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student practices a real skill (trade, art, technical) across multiple attempts, each with specific feedback
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides what to focus on improving in each subsequent attempt
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what changed between the first and later attempts

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a specific, real improvement across attempts, not just general 'it got better'
